posts.text: If you bill cleanups hourly, a leaf vac makes you faster but you earn less per job. How do you handle it? Flat rate or hourly plus a vac fee? If flat, what do you base it on (lot size, trees, leaf volume)? Cleanups per day with a 2-person crew: vac vs bagging?
